<!-- Search existing issues before submitting. Use the bug report or feature
     request template if it fits your topic better. -->

### Question or topic

Describe what you would like help with or discuss, and what you are trying to
accomplish with DepthAI ROS.

### Relevant context

Include the details needed to understand your question, such as your ROS
distribution, DepthAI ROS version, camera model, or launch configuration.
Paste commands, configuration, and logs as text in fenced code blocks when useful.

### What you have tried

Describe what you have already tried or read and where you are still unsure.
Include links to related documentation or issues, if applicable.

### Additional context (optional)

Add examples, screenshots, or other details that help explain the topic.
